extraction.Name: Ernest Bordeaux
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent was recorded July 30, 1920, by Richard Jones
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and sold at Sheriff's sale
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged by Ernest Bordeaux and wife to F. Lewis McCullough and John F. Murphy for $1000.00; mortgage dated July 12, 1920; mortgage was assigned to Katherine McCullough August 3, 1920; land was sold at Sheriff's sale on account of this mortgage on May 24, 1924; mortgage was released May 23, 1925 by Alex Bordeaux, Sr.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Tax certificate 6534 for the year 1925 was issued against the land and subsequent tax was still due in February 1928
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739652 issued; Lots 3 and 4, and North half of Northeast quarter, section 18, township 42, north of range 28; receipt was signed by the allottee April 5, 1920; document received Rosebud, S.D., June 1929
